name: cvodex-auto-routing-api
description: Express API template with folder auto-routing, versioning, and hierarchical layout middlewares.

scripts.dev:log: mkdir -p logs && nodemon src/server.js 2>&1 | tee logs/dev.log
scripts.start:log: mkdir -p logs && node src/server.js 2>&1 | tee logs/start.log
scripts.syntax: node --check src/server.js && node --check src/app.js && node --check src/core/autoLoader.js && node --check src/api/v1/layout.js && node --check src/api/v1/auth/layout.js && node --check src/api/v1/auth/route.js && node --check src/api/v1/users/route.js && node --check src/api/v1/users/[id]/route.js && node --check src/api/v1/cv/route.get.js && node --check src/api/v1/cv/route.post.js && node --check src/api/v2/layout.js && node --check src/api/v2/health/route.js
